def feature_transform(panel, subset):
    labs = np.concatenate([s['lab_id'] for s in panel])
    refs = np.vstack([s['ref_coupons'] for s in panel])
    strata = np.concatenate([s['stratum'] for s in panel])
    xx = np.vstack([s['coupon_features_raw'] for s in panel])
    x = subset['coupon_features_raw'].copy()
    for l in np.unique(labs):
        ix = labs == l
        P = refs[ix]
        mu = np.median(P.mean(0))
        sd = np.median(P.std(0))
        xx[ix] = (xx[ix] - mu) / sd
        j = subset['lab_id'] == l
        x[j] = (x[j] - mu) / sd
    (_, i, n) = np.unique(np.column_stack((labs, strata)), axis=0, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    w = 1 / n[i, None]
    return np.where(np.isnan(x), np.nansum(xx * w, 0) / np.sum(w * ~np.isnan(xx), 0), x)

def _features(train, test):
    splits = (train, test)
    labs = np.concatenate([s['lab_id'] for s in splits])
    strata = np.concatenate([s['stratum'] for s in splits])
    refs = np.vstack([s['ref_coupons'] for s in splits])
    x = np.vstack([s['coupon_features_raw'] for s in splits])
    for lab in np.unique(labs):
        rows = labs == lab
        panel = refs[rows]
        panel = np.sort(panel, axis=0)
        center = np.median(panel.mean(axis=0))
        scale = np.median(panel.std(axis=0))
        x[rows] = (x[rows] - center) / scale
    (_, cells, counts) = np.unique(np.column_stack((labs, strata)), axis=0, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    w = 1.0 / counts[cells, None]
    observed = ~np.isnan(x)
    means = np.nansum(w * x, axis=0) / (w * observed).sum(axis=0)
    return np.split(np.where(observed, x, means), [len(train['lab_id'])])

def _design(taus, past, hold, features, dt, times):
    age = np.cumsum(dt[::-1])[::-1] - dt
    memory = np.exp(-age[:, None] / taus) * -np.expm1(-dt[:, None] / taus)
    gap = hold[:, None] - past @ memory
    curve_branch = gap[:, None, :] * -np.expm1(-times[:, None] / taus)
    curve_drift = times[None, :, None] * features[:, None, :]
    curve = np.concatenate((curve_branch, curve_drift), axis=2)
    rate = np.column_stack((gap / taus, features))
    return (curve, rate)

def solve_batch(dataset: dict) -> dict:
    (train, test) = (dataset['train'], dataset['test'])
    (dt, times) = (np.asarray(dataset['past_dt']), np.asarray(dataset['eval_times']))
    (xtr, xte) = _features(train, test)
    cal = dataset['calibration_load_cells']
    bridge = _bridge(cal['bridge_raw'], cal['true_channel_loads'])
    (past, hold, features) = _inputs(train, xtr, bridge)
    (taus, theta) = _fit(past, hold, features, dt, times, train['strain_curves_obs'] - train['strain_0'][:, None], train['instant_rate_obs'])
    (curve, rate) = _design(taus, *_inputs(test, xte, bridge), dt, times)
    return {'estimated_taus': taus, 'hereditary_weights': theta, 'predicted_strain': test['strain_0'][:, None] + curve @ theta, 'initial_rate_pred': rate @ theta}
